title: Role
description: An agent role (PM, Architect, Developer, QA, DevOps). Defines the agent's job, model, base tools, knowledge, permission ceiling, approval gates and limits. Platform-specific behavior comes from skill packs.

model.description: LLM settings. Kept per role so cheap models can run simple roles and stronger models the hard ones.

instructions.description: Path to the role's system prompt (Markdown), relative to the role file.

consumes.description: Handoff document types this role reads.

produces.description: Handoff document types this role writes.

tools.description: Base tools from the framework's tool registry, available on every task regardless of skill pack.

knowledge.description: Retrieval sources available on every task. Skill packs add more.

skill_packs.description: How this role uses skill packs. Omit for roles that don't use packs (e.g. PM).

mode.description: required: a task must have a matching pack or it is rejected. optional: run without one if none matches.

select_by.description: task.platform: load the one pack matching the task's platform (Developer, QA, DevOps). project.platforms: load every pack the project uses (Architect, who designs across platforms).

use.description: Which parts of the pack to load. Omit to load all. E.g. the Architect needs pack knowledge but not build tools.

run_in.description: Working directory for pack tools and checks. repo: the platform's repo (Developer edits it in place). checkout: a clean checkout of the PR at ${task.checkout} (QA, so it never tests the Developer's working copy).

allowed.description: Pack ids this role may load. Omit to allow any pack that lists this role in applies_to.

permissions.description: Permission CEILING. A skill pack can request permissions, but effective permissions = pack request ∩ this ceiling.

gates.description: Points where a human must approve before the pipeline continues.

max_retries.description: Max times a task can come back from QA before escalating to a human.

scope.description: task: forget after each task. project: keep notes across tasks in the same project.

persist.description: What the role writes to project memory (e.g. lessons from failed QA runs).

artifactType.description: Handoff document types. Formats are defined separately (handoff schemas).

toolRef.description: Tool registry id, e.g. fs.read, git.commit, github.pr.create, rag.search.

location.description: Glob, URL or index name. May use ${project.*} variables.
